what: Claude Code Orchestrator host protocol + client + UI types, vendored byte-for-byte (team contract v2 §8; host-protocol.ts 'list_workers' structured answer RULES: a vendored copy records the commit it was copied from and is checked byte-identical to it). Never edit these copies: re-copy them and update the commit and the hashes. test/cco-vendor.mjs checks all three.
upstream: Claude Code Orchestrator v2.0.0 (https://github.com/Toragonite/claude-code-orchestrator, tag v2.0.0)
copiedWith: git -C <claude-code-orchestrator checkout> show <commit>:<from> > src/vendored/cco/<file> (each file redirected as is: no editor, no formatter, no line-ending change)
changedSincePrevious: none: all three files are byte-identical at the previous commit and at the v2.0.0 release commit; re-pinned to the public release tag.
layout: host-protocol.ts imports type-only from '../uiTypes' (its upstream place is src/mcp/, uiTypes.ts is src/). Here the copies sit side by side, so src/vendored/uiTypes.ts is a one-line type re-export of ./cco/uiTypes — not a vendored file, and erased at build time. uiTypes.ts carries one runtime value (RUN_LOGIN_FAILURE_DETAIL); whoever needs it imports it from ./cco/uiTypes directly (the frontend's src/workers/model.ts does), never through the type-only shim.
